name: Malfunction — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Malfunction from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Malfunction" but are not part of the Malfunction entry, which is unchanged.

School transmutation; Level machinesmith 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one construct or drone
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell duplicates the effects of confusion, but may target a construct. The target becomes immobile and takes no actions, save for attacks of opportunity. If cast upon a drone, the drone is destroyed.
